purpose: Behavioral checks: run each scenario against a suitable fixture repository and compare the review against the expected behavior. Complements trigger-queries.json, which only tests invocation.

cases.name: single-implementation adapter boundary
cases.scenario: An interface has exactly one implementation, but it isolates a third-party SDK and is used as a test seam.
cases.expect: Element verdict KEEP; the review cites the adapter/test-seam boundary instead of flagging the lone implementation.

cases.name: MQ without scale evidence
cases.scenario: A feature routes one synchronous step through a message queue; no metrics, SLA, incidents, or isolation requirement exist in the repository.
cases.expect: Scale-and-risk test fails; element verdict SIMPLIFY or DEFER; never KEEP justified by hypothetical growth.

cases.name: look-alike types with invariants
cases.scenario: A domain type mirrors its persistence type field-for-field but enforces invariants in its constructors.
cases.expect: Review checks invariants and ownership before any merge recommendation; expected element verdict KEEP.

cases.name: ambiguous scope
cases.scenario: The request names a module containing three independently traceable features.
cases.expect: Review asks the user to pick a boundary, or states the narrowest coherent one, before deep tracing.

cases.name: mixed feature
cases.scenario: One feature contains a justified cache (production metrics exist) and a speculative rule engine (one consumer, no confirmed second).
cases.expect: Overall verdict reflects the dominant element and lists element-level exceptions; no blanket KEEP or SIMPLIFY.
